title: Practice: the coordinator's last step in a research run (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 a full run with agreement returns claims with every source and a complete status
cases.says: A full run with agreement: claims with every source, a complete status and the all-clear note

cases.id: e1 no results leave every scope a gap and say not researched
cases.says: No results: every scope is a gap, not researched

cases.id: e2 a scope the plan never covered and a scope whose search failed read differently in the note
cases.says: A scope the plan never covered and a scope whose search failed read differently in the note

cases.id: e3 two values for one claim are a conflict that names both sources and no claim
cases.says: Two values for one claim are a conflict naming both sources and no claim

cases.id: e4 partial results are kept and flagged but do not cover the scope and a retry that worked clears the error
cases.says: Partial results kept and flagged, not covering their scope, and an error that a retry made up for disappears

cases.id: e5 a result with no findings does not cover its scope
cases.says: An ok result with no findings does not cover its scope

cases.id: e6 claims sources and scopes come out in a fixed order without duplicates
cases.says: Claims sorted, sources in arrival order without duplicates, scopes in the order of required
